text: Novo targets 5+ multi-blockbuster launches by 2030 and DKK 150B+ in risk-adjusted pipeline sales by 2035. Obesity and diabetes remain foundational alongside blood, endocrine, liver, and cardiovascular areas. Shares traded 5.4% lower.

meta.note: Strategic targets and the contemporaneous share move occupy the same disclosed event window.

text: The White House bars CNN, MS NOW and Politico from its grounds and revokes reporter credentials. The three outlets jointly seek federal restoration of access under First and Fifth Amendment claims.

meta.note: Government access authority and constitutional access claims remain simultaneously active.

text: Bitcoin traded near $84,256 after reaching $85,229, its highest level since late January. The asset remains below its October 2025 high above $126,000. The Senate's blocked Clarity Act leaves federal crypto oversight divided between existing SEC and CFTC structures.

meta.note: Price structure and regulatory structure coexist without establishing a directional relationship.

text: The U.S. position retains developer liability for AI systems without a federal liability shield. U.S. and Chinese officials formalized AI dialogue and discussed a communication channel for AI incidents, with further talks planned in Shenzhen.

meta.note: Domestic liability and bilateral coordination occupy distinct layers within the same policy event.

text: ABC, CBS, NBC and Fox declined to replace CNN after the White House blocked CNN from its assigned TV pool duties. The five-network pool suspended coverage of events designated for presidential pool coverage while other pool functions remained active.

meta.note: Withdrawal applies to designated presidential TV pool coverage, not the entire White House press pool.

text: AMD shares rose 9% to an intraday record of $613.92, placing market capitalization above $1 trillion for the first time. Shares gained about 24% across five sessions and more than 180% year to date, alongside 107% year-over-year Data Center revenue growth.

meta.note: Market capitalization and operating growth are distinct measurements within the same disclosed structure.

text: Paramount and state attorneys general settled litigation challenging its $110B Warner Bros. Discovery merger. Terms impose U.S. production and theatrical-release commitments, separate cable negotiations, labor provisions, and independent CBS News and CNN governance.

meta.note: Resolution applies to the state legal contest; compliance obligations remain active after closing.

text: Trump reiterated support for continued AI development while identifying DOJ and other law-enforcement bodies as available enforcement mechanisms. DOJ separately states that existing criminal laws apply to AI-related conduct without defining its role as AI regulation.

meta.note: Enforcement is condition-granted; no new AI regulatory mechanism was specified.

text: Eli Lilly says Foundayo accounts for one-third of new U.S. GLP-1 pill patients. The company broke ground on a $6.5B Houston facility for Foundayo and other small-molecule ingredients, adding to more than $50B in manufacturing commitments since 2020.

meta.note: Patient-share and manufacturing figures describe separate commercial and production layers.
